data.title: 阿尔法 · 指挥官书房的红茶片刻
data.description: 温暖壁炉火光映照着书房的大理石案几。阿尔法端着精致骨瓷茶杯递到身前，纯白露背长裙衬托着优雅温婉的身段，唇角勾起唯有独处时才会展露的会心笑意。
data.location: luxurious commander office with roaring stone fireplace and velvet drapery
data.action: sitting elegantly beside antique mahogany desk, presenting a steaming porcelain teacup, looking at viewer with warm gentle gaze
data.lighting: warm amber fireplace glow highlighting delicate bare shoulders and radiant blonde locks
data.mood: intimate domestic serenity, relaxed noble elegance, warm respite
data.promptProse: Sitting beside a fireplace in a white backless gown, blonde Alpha offers a steaming teacup with a fond gentle smile.
data.animaCaption: Sitting beside the crackling fireplace with a teacup and saucer, she smiles with warm affection in the hearth glow.
